product_metadata.title: AROMUSTIME 16 Inch Metal Platform Bed Frame / 3,500 lbs Heavy Duty Steel Slat Easy Assembly Mattress Foundation/Noise Free/Box Spring Replacement, King
features: 【Super Sturdy】Multi-point structural bed-legs and full frame load-bearing design make your bed safer & firm, withstand 3000+ pounds of static pressure, quiet noise-free and non-shake.
【Safety Protect】Half an inch smaller frame size design ensures your shins will not hit the the metal edges directly, perfect match your mattress and bedshirt.
【Easy Assembly】Integrated compact design can set up in minutes,all the required hardware and tools are included/ Headboard compatible.
【Ample Storage】16 inches high bed frame with 14 inches valuable storage space under the bed, Eliminates the need of box Spring.
【Warranty】Minimize packaging and Faster & smarter delivery, 5 year limited manufacturer warranty.
